title: Forge du volcan
style: Soft painterly stadium diorama, original design: no text, logos, ball emblems or recognisable venue. Crowd as a soft colour mass. Values one to two steps darker than the pixel-art creatures, calm and low-contrast behind them (stands band and landmark base), detail and the brightest accents kept to the upper sky and the edges.
plate: A dark volcanic cone against a blazing orange sky, smoke billowing from the crater lit from below, glowing lava rivers down its flanks, distant ridges in the haze, and two forge chimneys. Basalt terraces with ember-lit iron rails, brazier masts.
court: Dark basalt column tiles with a few thin glowing lava seams kept away from the pads, ash dusting, amber markings and an inlaid six-rhombus sigil.
value: Bright horizon band behind a dark triangular cone; dark top and dark court.
